_generated: Hint, not a label: area:<app> labels are not enumerated here. oc-github creates them on demand from the target repo's AGENTS.md front matter apps: keys. Skip every key starting with '_' when creating labels.
prd: PRD umbrella issue for one feature: problem, solution, user stories, spec link, slices, out of scope. Closes when its last slice merges.
slice: One vertical slice of a PRD — every layer it needs in one PR, mergeable to main on its own.
area:db: Touches migrations or the database schema; changes follow expand/contract.
area:infra: Touches infra, CI workflows or deployment wiring.
risk:security: Security-sensitive slice; adds the security-auditor review.
status:ready: All blockers closed; waiting to be built.
status:in-progress: A slice session is building it.
status:in-review: PR open; waiting on review and the PR monitor.
status:blocked: Cannot proceed; see the issue body for the reason.
status:cleanup-pending: Merged slice; central build still owes issue closure, parent PRD check and label cleanup.
flag-removal: Removes a feature flag introduced by an earlier slice.
